_comment: THING v5.1 — LLM Intent Classification Schema. Used by llm_intent_classifier.py to build system prompts.

intents.name: open_app
intents.description: Open, launch, or start a desktop application or software.

entities.app_name: string — name of the application (e.g. 'spotify', 'chrome', 'calculator', 'vs code')

intents.name: close_app
intents.description: Close, kill, or exit a currently running application.

entities.app_name: string — name of the application to close

intents.name: play_youtube
intents.description: Search for and play a video or music on YouTube.

entities.query: string — search query (e.g. 'lofi hip hop', 'latest mr beast video', 'interstellar soundtrack')

intents.name: media_control
intents.description: Control playback of media (YouTube, Spotify, etc.) including pausing, skipping, and full screen.

entities.type: string — one of: pause, resume, next, previous, stop, fullscreen, skip_forward, skip_backward

intents.name: control_system
intents.description: Adjust system settings such as volume, brightness, screenshots, and power states.

entities.type: string — one of: volume_up, volume_down, volume_mute, volume_unmute, brightness_up, brightness_down, take_screenshot, take_photo, open_camera, lock, shutdown, restart

intents.name: scroll_screen
intents.description: Scroll the active window up or down.

intents.name: get_time
intents.description: Query the current time.

intents.name: get_date
intents.description: Query today's date or day of the week.

intents.name: get_weather
intents.description: Query the current weather conditions for a location.
examples: is it going to rain today

intents.name: search_web
intents.description: Perform a general web search using Google or another engine.

intents.name: open_url
intents.description: Navigate to a specific website or URL.

intents.name: type_and_send
intents.description: Type text into the active text field/input.

entities.press_enter: boolean — whether to simulate Enter key after typing

intents.name: send_whatsapp
intents.description: Send a WhatsApp message to a saved contact. Use context to resolve 'him', 'her', or 'them'.
examples: send mom a message saying I'll be late
message my manager that I'm sick

intents.name: send_sms
intents.description: Send a normal SMS message (mobile to mobile). This uses the system's default messaging app (e.g. Phone Link).
examples: text 8887776665 saying I will be there

intents.name: send_email
intents.description: Compose and send an email.

entities.contact_name: string — recipient name or email address

examples: send an email to Priya saying the report is ready
email my boss about the deadline

intents.name: query_about_me
intents.description: Ask THING about the user's identity, preferences, or saved facts.

entities.query: string — the question about the user

examples: what do you know about me

intents.name: remember_fact
intents.description: Save a new piece of information into long-term memory.

entities.fact: string — the fact to be remembered

intents.name: forget_fact
intents.description: Delete a previously saved fact from memory.

entities.fact: string — the fact or category to forget

examples: forget what I said about dark mode

intents.name: browser_nav
intents.description: Navigate the web browser (back, refresh, etc.).

entities.type: string — one of: back, refresh, new_tab, close_tab

intents.name: vision_query
intents.description: Analyze, describe, or read what is currently visible on the user's screen. Use this when the user asks what is on their screen, wants something read, or wants a document/error/graph explained.

entities.query: string — what the user wants to know about their screen (e.g. 'describe it', 'summarize', 'read the error', 'explain the graph')

examples: summarize the document I have open

intents.name: camera_recognition
intents.description: Analyze, recognize, and describe people, user actions, or the environment using the webcam. Use this when the user asks who is in front of the camera, what they are doing, describes their room or environment, asks you to look at/scan them, or asks to recognize a person.

entities.query: string (optional) — what the user wants to know (e.g. 'who is this', 'what am I doing', 'describe the room')

examples: who is in front of the camera
what am I doing right now
look at me and say what I am doing

intents.name: ui_click
intents.description: Locate a specific UI element visible on the screen and click it. Use this when the user says to click, press, or tap a specific button, icon, or link that is visible on screen.

entities.target: string — description of the element to click (e.g. 'the blue submit button', 'the X close icon', 'the search bar', 'the login button')

intents.name: stop
intents.description: Immediately stop the current action, speaking, or process.

intents.name: multi_step
intents.description: A compound command with multiple actions to be performed in sequence.
examples: check the weather and then search for umbrellas
send a message to raj and then lock my pc
open chrome, go to youtube, and play lofi
describe my screen and then lock my pc

intents.name: check_cpu_usage
intents.description: Check the system's current CPU/processor usage and active resource-heavy processes.

intents.name: check_ram_usage
intents.description: Check the system's virtual memory/RAM usage and identify the heaviest processes.

intents.name: summarize_day
intents.description: Get a summary of the user's activities, commands, and chat interactions with the assistant today.
examples: give me a summary of today

intents.name: chat
intents.description: General conversation, jokes, advice, or questions that don't require a system action.
examples: what is the meaning of life

intents.name: spotify_play
intents.description: Play a track, album, or playlist on Spotify using the official Spotify SDK (no browser required). Use when the user explicitly mentions Spotify or asks to play music via Spotify.

entities.query: string — track, album, artist, or playlist name (e.g. 'Blinding Lights', 'Discover Weekly', 'Daft Punk')

examples: put on some Daft Punk on Spotify
play the album Random Access Memories

intents.name: spotify_pause
intents.description: Pause Spotify playback via SDK.

intents.name: spotify_resume
intents.description: Resume Spotify playback via SDK.

intents.name: spotify_skip
intents.description: Skip to the next track on Spotify via SDK.

intents.name: spotify_previous
intents.description: Go to the previous track on Spotify via SDK.
examples: play the last song again on Spotify

intents.name: spotify_volume
intents.description: Set the Spotify playback volume to a specific percentage.

intents.name: spotify_now_playing
intents.description: Ask what song is currently playing on Spotify.
examples: what song is this on Spotify

intents.name: calendar_query
intents.description: Query the user's Google Calendar for upcoming events. Use when asked about schedule, meetings, events, or calendar for today, tomorrow, or this week.

entities.timeframe: string — one of: today, tomorrow, this_week

examples: do I have any meetings tomorrow

intents.name: calendar_create
intents.description: Create a new event on the user's Google Calendar.
examples: add dentist appointment on Friday at 10am
create an event called Team Sync on May 25 at 2pm

intents.name: slack_send
intents.description: Send a message to a Slack channel using the Slack API.
examples: send a slack message to #general saying hello everyone
message the dev-team channel about the deploy

intents.name: slack_read
intents.description: Read recent messages from a Slack channel.

entities.count: integer (optional) — number of messages to read (default 5)

examples: what's the latest in the dev channel

intents.name: slack_channels
intents.description: List the available Slack channels.
examples: what channels do I have on Slack

intents.name: unknown
intents.description: Fallback for when a command cannot be classified.
